description: Eliminate the exact profile's 35.78-us grouped upper-copy node from batch-8 n=2048 replay. Make each independent graph chain's first factor, panel, and update nodes read stable original-input tiles directly and materialize every physical-upper output tile while preserving once-zeroed lower storage, post-factor wave releases, direct TF32 STRSM, mandatory cleanup, all other dispatches, caller-stream semantics, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Removed grouped preparation and passed stable source views into the first per-sample n2048 factor, panel, and update nodes: the first factor read its diagonal from input, first panel waves read unsolved tiles from input, and first updates read accumulators from input while retaining output-resident solved operands, release events, direct TF32 STRSM, and final cleanup. Slice build, all 17 tests, and the fresh-input guard passed, but the active batch8/n2048 benchmark cell returned NaN/Inf, so no aggregate metric was emitted.

Repaired the no-copy graph by using the first 14-CTA panel wave to materialize the disjoint outer 256x1792 input panel and the first 56-CTA update wave to materialize the disjoint 1792x1792 physical-upper trailing accumulator. Combined with direct-source factor/internal-panel/internal-update reads, every physical-upper tile is now written before direct TF32 STRSM and outer rank-k consume it; once-zeroed lower storage, post-factor releases, final cleanup, caller queues, and all other paths remain intact. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate improved from parent 798.740 to 783.805 us; target batch8/n2048 mean was outlier-inflated to 2138.869 us by one 59.2-ms sample, with 1815.872-us best versus the parent trial's 1539.936-us best.

Replaced the fused scalar outer-panel and trailing-upper copies with aligned float4 loads/stores through a linked device helper, retaining scalar diagonal-alignment prefixes. Slice build and official validation passed because their shapes do not enter the batch8/n2048 dispatch, but the active benchmark reached that path and Numba rejected array arguments where the external helper requires raw float pointers; no target or aggregate metric was emitted.

Completed aligned float4 materialization by passing raw source/output pointers into the linked device copy helper. The first panel wave copies its outer rectangle four floats per instruction; the first update wave handles each diagonal-alignment prefix scalarly then copies the trailing physical-upper suffix as float4, while direct-source math, graph dependencies, direct TF32 STRSM, cleanup, and all other paths remain unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate measured 796.985 us amid broad untouched-cell slowdown. Target batch8/n2048 mean was inflated to 2256.469 us by one 115.5-ms sample; excluding it gives 1687.4 us, and the clean best improved from scalar Trial1 1815.872 to 1645.248 us, near the 1539.936 parent floor.

Acted on the exact Trial3 hosted profile by widening only the first per-chain panel/update launches to one 148-CTA B200 wave. The original 14/56 math CTAs retain their coordinator rotations; added CTAs perform only disjoint float4 outer-panel/trailing-upper copies, while all later launch grids, post-factor releases, direct TF32 STRSM, mandatory cleanup, caller queues, and other dispatches remain unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate reached a brief-best 780.288 us versus Trial1 783.805 and parent 798.740. Target batch8/n2048 mean was inflated to 2004.163 us by one 62.7-ms sample; excluding it gives 1699.4 us, with 1664.768-us best versus profiled Trial3 1687.4/1645.248. Exact Trial3 profile job 2f355f3d5b3142319f33d3f0df98ef14 directly motivated this change; no additional hosted request was launched.

Eliminated the 1792x1792 first trailing-upper materialization entirely by compiling the direct-FP32 CuTe rank-k with distinct C and D pointers: the first outer update reads stable original-input C and writes output D, while later stages alias C=D as before. The 148-CTA outer-panel materialization, direct TF32 STRSM, internal direct-source stages, release DAG, and cleanup remain. Slice build and validation passed; active batch8/n2048 itself passed and reached a 1541.056-us best, but the full benchmark later failed at batch2/n4096 because its shared rank-k wrapper still used the old three-argument call signature, so no aggregate metric was emitted.

Made the distinct-C/D CuTe rank-k wrapper backward-compatible so batch2/n4096 and other existing callers continue aliasing C=D, while only the first batch8/n2048 outer update reads its trailing accumulator directly from stable input. This removes the entire 1792x1792 upper copy; the widened first panel wave still materializes the in-place STRSM panel, internal factor/panel/update stages read source directly, and release events plus cleanup remain intact. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate reached a brief-best 778.734 us versus 780.288 Trial4 and 798.740 parent. Target mean 1870.372 us contained one 59.8-ms outlier; excluding it gives 1579.5 us, and best reached 1546.624 us versus Trial4 1699.4/1664.768 and parent trial 2049.244/1539.936.

Specialized the remaining outer-panel materialization: only the 134 copy-only CTAs now participate, leaving all 14 MathDx panel CTAs on the factor/solve critical path, and each linked helper call transfers two adjacent float4 vectors so one row needs at most one call per active thread. Distinct-C/D first rank-k, stable-source internal stages, 148 total first-panel CTAs, release DAG, direct TF32 STRSM, cleanup, and other paths remain. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. Aggregate measured 785.715 us amid slower untouched n512/n4096/large cells. Target mean was inflated to 2070.800 us by one 100.3-ms sample; excluding it gives 1577.0 us, with 1545.472-us best versus Trial6 1579.5/1546.624, a small clean target improvement.

Right-sized the first panel launch from 148 to 74 CTAs: 60 copy-only plus 14 MathDx CTAs per chain. Four released first-wave chains now expose 296 blocks collectively, enough to cover B200 while leaving substantially less queued work ahead of the paired second-wave factors. Paired-float4 row copies, distinct-C/D first rank-k, direct TF32 STRSM, graph events, cleanup, and all later grids remain. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. Aggregate reached a brief-best 778.098 us versus Trial6 778.734 and Trial7 785.715. Target mean was inflated to 1916.536 us by one 70.7-ms sample; excluding it gives 1571.1 us, with 1544.512-us best versus Trial7 1577.0/1545.472.

Completed the first-panel grid sweep at 38 CTAs per chain (24 copy-only plus 14 MathDx), so four first-wave chains expose 152 blocks in aggregate. The complete direct-source design remained unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. Aggregate measured 800.121 us amid severe untouched-cell slowdown and several outliers. Target mean 2198.198 us contained one 125.0-ms sample; excluding it gives 1580.9 us, with 1546.672-us best, slower than the 74-CTA Trial8 at 1571.1/1544.512. The sweep therefore measured 74 CTAs as the stronger tested concurrency point; larger 148 reached 1577.0/1545.472.

Completed the concurrency sweep with 78 CTAs (64 copy-only plus 14 MathDx), giving each copy CTA exactly four outer-panel rows. All direct-source mechanics and non-target paths remained fixed. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. Aggregate was outlier-inflated to 808.054 us, including a 6.95-ms n256 sample and slower untouched n512/n1024 cells. Target mean 2278.795 us contained one 142.6-ms sample; excluding it gives 1573.5 us, with 1544.848-us best. This was slightly slower than the 74-CTA Trial8 at 1571.1/1544.512 but faster than 38 CTAs at 1580.9/1546.672, selecting 74 among the tested grid points.

Restored the measured 74-CTA selection after completing the 38/74/78 sweep. Source is byte-identical to Trial8: 60 paired-float4 copy CTAs plus 14 MathDx CTAs, first outer rank-k reads stable input C and writes output D, first internal stages read source directly, lower storage starts zero, and release events/direct TF32 STRSM/final cleanup/all other dispatches remain. Final slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. This rerun aggregate was outlier-inflated to 798.413 us, including 3.61-ms n256 and 123.0-ms n2048 samples; target best was 1545.104 us. The source-identical Trial8 measured 778.098 us aggregate and 1571.1-us clean target mean/1544.512 best, so Trial8 remains the representative measurement for this exact selected source.

Selected commit 0224ad48705863f8d80778521570605a1f86796c is source-identical to Trial8 and removes the profiled 35.78-us grouped upper-copy node. Each chain's first factor/internal panel/internal update reads stable original input; 60 copy-only paired-float4 CTAs materialize only the outer panel required by in-place direct TF32 STRSM; and the first outer CuTe rank-k uses distinct original-input C and output D pointers, eliminating the entire 1792x1792 trailing-upper copy. Once-zeroed lower storage, post-factor second-wave releases, caller queues, mandatory cleanup, fresh-input caching, every other dispatch, and the full grid remain. All wrapped builds, 17-test validations, fresh-input guards, and succeeded full-grid trials passed. The representative source-identical Trial8 measured 778.098 us versus 798.740 parent; batch8/n2048 clean mean/best were 1571.1/1544.512 us versus the selected parent lineage's roughly 1858.1/1528.864 us. Final rerun was outlier-inflated to 798.413 us but retained a 1545.104-us best. Exact final hosted job 9d5d6db956824e87be9fdbe4a5554e5f proves the parent copy is absent and measures first factor/panel/update at 11.46/9.92/7.42 us versus parent copy+factor+panel+update at 35.78+11.17+7.01+7.14 us, about 32.3 us removed before overlap; canonical final artifacts are brief-76-trial-11-0224ad48705863f8d80778521570605a1f86796c.*. Keep this line moving with a prewarmed capture that reaches the distinct-C/D outer rank-k, a first-panel copy implementation that avoids allocating MathDx resources to copy-only CTAs, and graph scheduling variants that overlap the 74-CTA panel materialization with released second-wave factor nodes without changing direct TF32 STRSM.
